title: rename_passage
description: Rename a passage and rewrite every incoming [[...]] link across the story atomically. Also updates story.start_passage if the renamed passage was the start. This is the flagship graph-integrity operation (Constitution Principle III).
clarification_triggers: new_name collides with an existing passage: ask suffix | replace | cancel
old_name does not exist: ask which passage was meant (valid_answers = nearest matches)
acceptance_test_hooks: US1 scenario 4: rename Hallway→Corridor with 3 incoming links → all rewritten, 0 broken
Edge case: renaming the start passage updates story.start_passage
